# Acme Developer Portal

> Guides and reference for the Acme payments platform.

The portal explains how a client sends payments and how the ledger records them.

## Guides

- [Getting started](/web/guides/getting-started): Set up a client and send the first payment.
- [Ledger](/web/guides/ledger.html): How the ledger records settled payments.
- [Incident review](/web/guides/incident-review): The review of the October incident.

## Reference

- [Payments API](/web/reference/payments-api): Endpoints, limits and errors.
- [Status page]({{offsite}}/): The public status of the Acme services.

## Optional

- [Release notes](/web/releases/): Past releases of the platform.
